script.text: With the help of his friends, Yusei stopped the Divine Temple from crashing into New Domino City.
6 months later, Yusei created Fortune - a computer program designed to control Ener-D safely.
Meanwhile, Lazar was sworn in as the new mayor of New Domino City.
As the new - and first-ever - mayor of this fine city, my first order is to return the city to its people.
By having a government run by elected officials.
Whoa! Lazar is the mayor? That's crazy! ...But then again, if I can join Sector Security, anything can happen!
Congratulations, Professor Fudo.
Please don't call me "Professor". That's my father - not me.
No need to feel embarrassed. You've far exceeded your father's expectations. Your  Fortune program will supply New Domino City with unlimited energy.
So New Domino City will be the hub that connects cities around the world.
Yeah. The future is looking up, now that the future Zone predicted won't come to pass.
But I can't take all the credit. My friends and I did it together as a team.
Yes yes, of course. Always thinking about your team.
Now that you've completed your program, you should take some time for yourself. Breathe the air, travel the world. Decide what you want to do from now on.
But to be honest, I hope you'll stay in New Domino City.
But the decision is yours. See you later, Yusei.
Hey Yusei! Long time no see! Too busy to see your pal?
Sorry. It took longer than I expected to finish my program.
But you did, right? Nice, Yusei!
Thanks. So how are things with you?

Ugh. Trudge has me patrolling the streets night and day. I don't remember the last time I got more than an hour of sleep! But hey, can't complain. Who would've thought I'd ever be a cop, right? This city sure has changed.
No, we changed it. Together. As a team.
You're right.  Team 5D's forever.
Speaking of 5D's, why don't we all get together this weekend? It's been more than a while.
That's a great idea! I'm sure everyone will show up... except for one guy who's kinda hard to get in touch with.
Yeah... Jack. You still haven't heard from him?
Nope. I wonder where he's at? I'll give him a buzz, but don't keep your hopes up.
I can't believe your dueling is still improving.
Any weaknesses you had - and you barely had any to start with - are gone. I didn't stand a chance.
Your skills have reached a new level. But by the look on your face, you're not satisfied, are you.
No. I won't be satisfied until I defeat a certain someone.
Hey Yusei!
Hi!
Miss me?
Akiza, Leo, Luna! It's great to see you!
Aww - am I the last one here?
Crow! You're way late! So late that we already finished partying and were about to go home!
Whoa! That late?!?
He's joking. We haven't even started yet.
Later that night...
Yeah, it's nice keeping New Domino City safe and everything, but...
But?
Well…
Hmm...
Forget about me. What's up with you, Akiza? What are ya gonna do after you graduate? Cuz I think you should hit the pro leagues! With your skill, any team would be lucky to have you!
Don't choose my career path for me! Maybe I don't want to turn pro!
Uhh... Sorry if I struck a nerve!
People are always telling me what I should do. Like I don't have a choice in the matter!
Uh, you all wanna take it down a few degrees? Because Luna and I have some news to tell you. Our mom and dad sent us a message today.
Saying that we should all live together again.
That's great news! ...So why are you down in the dumps?
Because we'll have to leave New Domino City.
Oh...
Leo… Luna…
We haven't decided yet if we're gonna move or not, but we're wondering what we should do.
Because we love you guys. We don't want to leave New Domino City. I'm so confused...

Crow, Akiza - just like with Leo and Luna, I can tell you're wondering what you should do with your lives. Why else would you get so upset over innocent questions? Crow, I know you received an offer from a top pro league overseas.
You do?!?
And Akiza, you've been accepted to study abroad at one of the best medical schools in the world.
How did you know?
Your parents told me.
Akiza, you're going to be a doctor?
I… I don't know. I haven't decided yet.
Jack?
Where have you been?
Training.
Training for what?
I received an invitation from Ride Ace, the world's greatest Duel League. So I'm leaving New Domino City. Because I don't want to be just the King of a city, but the King of the world!
You're never gonna stop trying to be the King, are ya.
Of course not. Wouldn't you want to test your skills against the world?
Yusei, I know they sent you an invitation too.
Yeah, they did.
Of course they did. It'd be nuts if Yusei didn't get an invite from every Duel League in every nation!
Yusei, what are you going to do?
I'm not sure. I was so focusing on my Fortune program that I thought of nothing else. But now that it's finished...
You might not know what to do, but I do. We've accomplished everything we could as a team, so now I'm going to create my own legacy!
I will defeat everyone who stands in my way - even Team 5D's!
Jeez, thanks.
Jack, let's duel.
You want to duel me?
Whenever I'm not sure about what to do, dueling always clears my mind.
Very well. Because if I want to take on the world, I must be good enough to defeat you first!
Jack, can you believe that this is our first duel since the Fortune Cup?
We've been dueling side-by-side for so long that I've almost forgotten that we've dueled against each other.
Same here. But dueling with you instead of against you were some of my most favorite days.
Yes. But we can't live in the past. I've yearned to duel you again, and now is the time!
That's right! So let's give it our all!
You don't need to tell me twice!
